title: Quarc
teaser: Robotics hardware design and computer vision integration for non-destructive pipeline inspection.
headline: Robotics work where mechanical design, sensing, and computer vision had to survive extreme inspection conditions.
challenge: Pipeline inspection required a hardware system that could gather useful LiDAR and optical information without destructive testing.
outcome: Ali's robotics work connected hardware design and computer vision integration for inspection environments where reliability and legibility mattered.
bullets: Contributed robotics hardware design for non-destructive pipeline inspection.
Worked across LiDAR, optical sensing, and computer vision integration.
Helped frame extreme-environment inspection as a product and sensing problem, not just a mechanical one.
